start: GitHub copy of the app, a newer release published on GitHub

user_sees: The orange line 'A new version of MettleUp is ready' with 'Update'
must_not: The line on a Google Play copy
The line for a draft or pre-release

user_sees: The full screen 'Version <n> is ready' with up to 3 what-changed lines
must_not: An empty what-changed list shown as lines

steps.action: Tap the button to get it

start: Update line on the Workout tab, What's new lines known

steps.action: Tap "What's new" after the line's words
user_sees: The lines inside the bar and "Hide what's new"

start: Google Play copy with a Play update

user_sees: 'Downloading the new version. Keep using the app.' then 'The new version is ready.' with 'Restart'
must_not: A restart during an open workout ('It installs after your workout.' instead)

start: GitHub copy, no internet or GitHub refuses (rate limit), or the newest release has no phone APK

user_sees: No update line, or the last known line
must_not: A line pointing to a release with no phone APK

user_sees: The full screen closes; it asks again later
must_not: The full screen on every launch
The line still asks for the installed version

start: GitHub copy asks for the newest release

steps.action: The app asks GitHub at most every 6 hours
user_sees: Nothing new on screen when there is no update
must_not: Member data, gym code or install id sent with the question
